newsitem.title: USA: Template Software acquires German company.
newsitem.headline: Template Software acquires German company.

text.p: Template Software Inc said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire German-based Milestone Software GmbH and a minority interest in Milestone's Austrian affiliate for DM 12 million, or $7.44 million, and 90,000 shares.
An additional contingent consideration of about 78,000 shares would be payable to Milestone shareholders upon the attainment of certain future profit objectives, Template said.
The acquisition is expected to be completed on or before July 1, it said.
After the closing, Milestone would be renamed Template Software GmbH.
Template is a software technology and solutions company.
